# segment of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/segmentOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A structural segment is part of a larger whole — a work, release, installment, or another segment. Transitive; inverse of [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md) from [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) to [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md), [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use from the part's side to say a [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) belongs to a larger whole — a scene in a chapter, a chapter in a work; transitive, so nested structure closes up the spine.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for generic non-structural parthood (use [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)) and avoid asserting both directions redundantly — assert [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md) and read [`gmeow:hasSegment`](gmeow-hasSegment.md) as its inverse.

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:ContentSegment`](../classes/gmeow-ContentSegment.md) at its containing whole via [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md); it specializes [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), so generic consumers read parthood by inheritance and transitivity assembles the nesting.

- ex:scene3 [`gmeow:segmentOf`](gmeow-segmentOf.md) ex:chapter1.
